_doc: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF (carbon-filled nylon), printed, annealed and dry, for analysis: stiffness and strength along the layers (x-y) and across them (z). Nylon takes up water and softens: the sheet's specimens were dried and annealed at 80 °C for 12 hours, so a part kept in damp air is weaker. Low and high are the data sheet's own spread either side; measure your own (the lever bench does) and record it as kind measured.
name: pa_cf

modulus.rule: Young's modulus along the layers (x-y), ± 230, dry and annealed
modulus.source: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040), https://cdn.shopify.com/s/files/1/0380/5149/files/Bambu_PAHT-CF_Technical_Data_Sheet.pdf

modulus_z.rule: Young's modulus across the layers (z), ± 130, dry and annealed
modulus_z.source: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength.rule: Tensile strength along the layers (x-y), ± 7, dry and annealed
strength.source: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

strength_z.rule: Tensile strength across the layers (z), ± 3, dry and annealed
strength_z.source: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 527, GB/T 1040)

poisson.rule: Poisson's ratio (Bambu publish none): an estimate; a fibre-filled print differs along and across its fibres
poisson.source: An estimate of @rulecad/rules: no maker's data sheet gives one

density.source: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 1183)

softening.rule: Heat deflection temperature, ISO 75 at 0.45 MPa, annealed
softening.source: Bambu Lab PAHT-CF technical data sheet V2.0 (ISO 75)
